title: Oru Kai Osai
desc: A man loses his voice after his mother's shocking death. Later, he falls in love with a doctor, who comes to practise in his village and helps everyone.

title: Alayamani
desc: Thyagarajan, a lonely young man, develops a friendship with a virtuous man, Sekhar. However, complications arise when Thyagarajan falls in love with Sekhar's lover, Meena.

title: Otran
desc: A group of terrorists kidnaps Sudha and takes over her apartment to save their employer Robert. Karthik, a RAW agent, pretends to be a cook and goes to her house to capture the entire gang.
